notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The game version is updated to 1.1.0

update content:
1. Add a hot key to the refresh of the follower loot.

2. After completing purgatory difficulty, all torture difficulty will be unlocked directly.

3. Add 3 new difficulty: Challenge , every time the challenge difficulty increases by 1 level, all enemies will have 1 more trait.

4. Added new achievements, and fixed the bug that the achievements could not be completed in some special situations.

5. From hard to purgatory, each boss will add an additional passive effect, and no longer add it according to the number of times the boss is defeated.

6. After the tour starts, each new zone will add a map feature.

7. The number of Leilani’s hero features has been increased from 4 to 5, and the refresh cost has been increased to 100 diamonds.

8. Race synergies modification:
3 Human fight together: Increase dodge chance by 25%.
5 Bizarre fight together: When the attack hits, there is a 25% chance of causing poisonous blood to the target (debuff damage and prohibited from regenerating health).

9. Followers’ skills and traits modifications:
Ghost Sorcerer
Dharma brand (trait): increased range from 3 yards to 4 yards
Multiple missiles (trait): increased the number of missiles from 1 to 2

Gloomy Gargoyle
Drinking Blood (passive): Spell penetration is additionally increased, the value is equal to 20% of the spell leech
Baleful (trait) reworked: Renamed to Gorefiend: The conversion ratio of Drinking Blood attributes has been increased to 60%

Epee Knight
Revenge (passive): damage increased from 25% to 50%

Brutal Bear
State Deepening (passive): the damage for each layer of status increased from 3% to 10%

Flame Tauren
Broken Armor (passive): the effect of reducing armor and spell resistance has been increased from 1.5% to 5%, and can be stacked up to 99 layers

Soul Armor
Crushed Ice (passive): deal pure damage when attacking a frozen enemy

10. Each damage of poisoning increased from 100 to 125.

11. The effective range of Demon horned and Noble boots has been increased from 4 yards to 6 yards.

12. Fixed the bug that Thunder bom (the passive skill) of Thunder Golem would trigger more than one thunder.

13. Fixed the bug that the map exclusive effect of the Dirty Sewer was incorrectly damaged.

14.Fixed a bug that caused too many units on the field to get stuck, and added the upper limit of the number of all summons. 

15.Adjusted some data.

16.Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.9.01
notes.notes:
Because of major changes in the game data, the last expedition progress was forcibly terminated and returned to the tavern.
You will receive 2000 diamonds as a compensation reward.

update content:
1. The hero is no longer refreshed every expedition, but becomes a hero with fixed features, and no longer has debuff features. It will be unlocked according to the completed difficulty of the game and the diamonds, and the hero's life is back.

2. Cancel the follower level, and divide the follower into 4 quality levels: normal, rare, epic, and legendary. The corresponding cost is 6, 8, 10, and 12. The loot rate of different quality of the follower is related to the current leadership.

3. Cancel the personal synergies of the follower and become a follower trait, which will be unlocked according to the completed difficulty of the game and the diamonds. Once activated, it will take effect directly. At the same time, a large number of traits have been changed.

4. The equipment is separated from the loot of the follower (and the soul). The loot of the follower (and the soul) no longer uses crystals, but is purchased with gold coins, and the gold coin interest and additional rewards are added. The equipment loot will appear once every 2 battles, select 1 out of 3 equipments.

5. The equipment attributes are enhanced, but each equipment has only 1 attribute. The equipment has only 2 quality of normal and legendary. 3 normal equipments can be transmuted into a legendary equipment. The transmute will no longer fail and skip steps. Other rules are the same as before.

6. Suits are now unlocked according to the completed difficulty and diamonds of the game. After unlocking, they must be carried to play in order to take effect. The upper limit of the number of suits that can be carried is related to the difficulty of the completed game. At the same time, the components of the suits are optimized, each race and class change suits is increased to 3 types, corresponding to the equipment combination of normal attack, skill and defense.

7. Adjusted most of the race and class synergies, and added some synergies that works for all allies.

8. Canceled the fixed map features of each map, and added random elite enemy. The elite enemy carry random map features and will double the rewards after victory.

9. The featuregem is cancelled and the difficulty of the game is expanded. In addition to the original 4 difficulty, purgatory and 10 torture difficulties have been added. Difficulty increases the enemy’s HP and damage, and at the same time increases the diamond rewards obtained.

10. Reduced the number of maps in each zone, now it is can't re-challenge the completed zone before defeating the gemini lords.

11. The passive effect of the boss no longer increases according to the difficulty, but according to the number of times the boss challenged in an expedition.

12. The enemy no longer has equipment and  stars, but the growth of max health, damage and skill levels will be fixed according to the progress of the expedtion.

13. Modify and delete some of the original achievements, and add some new achievements.

There are a lot of small content changes in the game, please try it yourself!
This will be the last major version update of the EA version, and is the pre-version of the complete version. A large amount of content in the game will be directly integrated with the complete version.
We will update the complete version shortly after this.
Stay tuned~!

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.notes:
[b]Mechanical Core[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/fba065d042d44eef9f381255eabd252084ae7a42.jpg[/img]
Bizarre  Summoner  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Emergency Repair
When the basic attack hits, there is a 10% chance of repairing 1 cannon, full of health and resetting its existence time, if there is no cannon on the field, then 1 cannon will be summoned.

Active Skill: Summon Cannon
Summon 4 cannons to assist in attacking the enemy. The cannon cannot move, but has an unlimited range. The cannon lasts for 10 seconds.

Personal Synergy I: Sharp Bullet
Bullets from Mechanical Core and Cannon can penetrate enemies

Personal Synergy II: Multiple Fire
Mechanical Core and Cannon will simultaneously fire at 2 additional enemies in the front sector

Personal Synergy III: Powerful Repair
Emergency Repair can repair all cannons on the field. If there is no cannon on the field, you can summon 2 cannons


[b]Forest Dryad[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/ead9caf14d82d1231d5f11cbcdaedc70625beee0.jpg[/img]
Nature  Summoner  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Soul of Forest
Forest Dryad will become a spirit when dies. The effect of the spirit is the same as the summoned by Call of Nature.

Active Skill: Call of Nature
Summon a spirit next to the target. The spirit does not cause basic attacks. It causes an energy explosion every 2 seconds, causing spell damage to all enemies within 3 yards. The damage is equal to 5% of the spirit’s max health. Heals all allies in the range at the same time, equal to 2% of the max health of the spirit. Each energy explosion will consume the spirit’s current health, which is equal to 10% of the spirit’s max health.

Personal Synergy I: Purify Nature
When the spirit's energy explosion hits enemy, it will dispel 1 buff on each target

Personal Synergy II: Natural Hug
When the spirit's energy explosion hits allies, it will dispel 1 debuff on each target

Personal Synergy III: Heart of Nature
The spirit no longer consumes its own health when causing energy explosion


[b]Pirate Countess[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/0c3b8009f96bfeb6fa25c1284aa4faf53ff4c009.jpg[/img]
Human  Ranger  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Unstable Bullet
When the basic attack hits, there is a 10% chance that it will bounce to an enemy within 3 yards. The bullet can be bounced all the time, and the chance of each bounce is 10%.

Active Skill: Aiming shot
Continuously cast, fire 1 shot per second, consume 25 mana, fire 2 bullets, each bullet causes basic damage, and each bullet will cause the target to bleed.

Personal Synergy I: Rapid Fire
Aiming shot changed to 1 shot every 0.5 seconds

Personal Synergy II: Unstable Shoot
The bullet fired by the Aiming shot will also bounce, in the same way as the Unstable Bullet

Personal Synergy III: Burst Bullet
Increased the bullet bounce chance of Unstable Bullet to 50%

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.notes:
[b]Dragon Queen[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/46838b5a3aff795dfdd50bbe5f0d6035e91dedd2.jpg[/img]
Deamon  Guardian  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Dragon's Fire
Basic attacks no longer cause basic damage. Instead, Dragon Queen wrap herself with felfire, causing spell damage to all enemies within 2.5 yards. Each time the felfire deals damage, it will increase the dragon queen’s spell defense by 1%. 
(The damage of each star increases by 10%)

Active Skill: Fel Nova
Causes spell damage to all enemies within 4 yards, and reduces the damage caused by these enemies by 25% for 5 seconds, and prohibits them from restoring health for 4 seconds, Nova will cast 2 times.

Personal Synergy I: Heart of Fel
Every time Felfire deals damage, the dragon queen's basic defense and spell defense are increased by 2% each

Personal Synergy II: Fel Backlash
Every time the enemy hits the dragon queen, they will be damaged by the felfire

Personal Synergy III: Fel Skin
Increase the damage of Dragon's Fire and Fel Nova, equal to 100% of the spell defense


[b]Wild Hunter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/880cc41fb4ca82380d4c7575e73f1a5137272362.jpg[/img]
Savage  Assassin  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Bloody Claw
There is a 30% chance of causing the target to bleed when the basic attack crit.

Active Skill: Wild Roar
Cast roar, basic attack is increased by 80%, basic crit chance is increased by 30%, crit damage is increased by 50%, and the enemy cannot dodge attack for 5 seconds.

Personal Synergy I: Bloody Bite
Bloody Claw's trigger chance increased to 100%

Personal Synergy II: Blood Craving
If the current target’s health is below 50%, the wild hunter’s attack speed is increased by 75%

Personal Synergy III: Blood moon
Wild Roar's effect works on all ally assassins


[b]Doom Blade[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/07319827169f027e0ae896af508aebfe82acbb60.jpg[/img]
Human  Warrior  Cost 10

Passive Skill: Doom Judgment
When basic attack hits, there is a 20% chance to summon a doom sword next to a randomly enemy. Reduce basic crit chance of enemies within 1 yard of the sword by 10% (the effect cannot be superimposed), the sword will exist for 8 seconds.

Active Skill: Doom Strike
Launch 4 consecutive slashes on enemies within the fan-shaped area in front of the Doom Blade, each causing basic damage. The first 3 slashes will trigger Doom Judgment, and the fourth slash will detonate all existing doom sword on the field. All enemies within the effective range of doom sword will take basic damage, the enemies will be imprisoned (unmovable) for 3 seconds, and blinded (hit chance reduced by 50%) for 4 seconds.

Personal Synergy I: Doom Power
Doom Blade's damage to enemies within the doom sword is increased by 50%

Personal Synergy II: Doom Echo
The doom sword's range of influence has been expanded to 2.5 yards

Personal Synergy III: Death knell
The trigger chance of Doom Judgment is increased to 100%

notes.title: Updata to Version 0.7.02
notes.notes:
1. Modified the mechanism of reducing mana cost, and changed to restore mana after casting skills.

2. Modified the mechanism of block, changed the block value to reduce damage taken when blocking, now activating block will reduce the damage percentage of the current damage according to the block damage reduction rate.

3. The synergies of 2 guards, 4 guards, and 6 guards now have a 5% more block chance, and the explanation of the basic max health is optimized.

4. Modified the special attributes of the Hard steel, now the reflection damage is no longer a fixed value, but a percentage of the wearer's maximum health. (the Boss will not wear this equipment)

5. Modify the special attributes of the Gem bow to convert hit chance into additional damage taken reduction from crit. (originally converted to dodge)

6. The active skill damage type of Forester and Shadow Assassin is changed to basic damage.

7. Mana recovered per second will not take effect under continuous casting.

8. Adjusted the default dodge rate of all followers.

9. Now the enemies of Nightmare and Hell no longer reduce the number of race (class) synergies requirements by default, but gradually change this number according to the number of completed zones.

10. Modified the skills and personal synergies of the Dismemberer and the Stinger Scorpion.

11. Adjusted the enemy AI, now it is easier to find the enemy in front of the follower.

12. Fixed some bugs.

13. Modified game data.

notes.title: Version updated to 0.7.00
notes.notes:
1. Modified the synergies of class and race.

2. Modified all equipment, reduced the number of equipment attributes, and increased the value range of attributes.

3. Debuff damage can now be viewed in detail in the follower interface
   Increased the activation interval of all debuff damage to 1.5 seconds.
   The effect of the poisonous blood has been modified. Now the poisonous blood can be directly attached, and the poisonous blood can make the enemy unable to restore health.

4. Attributes that were originally multiplicative stacking, such as reduce cooldown, reduce skill cost, reduce time of control state, and reduce debuff damage taken, are now modified to additive stacking.

5. The default attributes of all followers have been modified. Now the default dodge chace, crit chace, crit damage, basic defense, and spell defense of the followers are all different.

6. Modify the skill damage type of some melee followers to basic damage.

7. The attack mode of the dismemberer was changed to throwing axe, and the range was increased to 5.5 yards.

8. Basic defense penetration and spell defense penetration can now reduce the target's defense to a negative number.

9. Modified the damage of all followers skills.

10. Speed up the actions of all followers to cast skills.

11. Added surrender in battle.

12. Modified some suit attributes and personal synergies.

13. Added a timer in battle.

14. Modified the default suit, now it will not loot the suit runes before defeating the gemini lords for the first time.

15. Added speed up button in battle.

16. Cancel the hero's life, and continue to challenge when the battle fails, the hero will not die.

17. Blessing of the dead will appear when the battle fails. You can exchange the blessing energy for the battle buff in this room. (the blessing energy replaces the hero's life before)

18. The selection of map features adds different levels of difficulty, corresponding to more or less map features and attribute rewards.

19. The loot tends to exist independently and is no longer associated with the enemy lineup, and the interface has been adjusted.

20. Adjusted the button and position of the store in the stash to make it more conspicuous.

21. Added a new achievement "Self-reliance: defeat the gemini lords without any blessings in hell difficulty".

22. Adjusted some data

23. Fixed some bugs

24. Optimized the performance

notes.title: game version is updated to 0.6.54
notes.notes:
The game version is updated to 0.6.54

1. Now you can sell the items in the stash in the tavern, and has a quick sale function.
  For the diamonds obtained by selling, you can purchase follower cards, personal synergies, suit runes, featuregems and expedition's paper at the exchange shop in the stash.

2. At the beginning of each expedition, diamonds can be exchanged for the currency used in this expedition.

3. Each time you enter a new map, map features are no longer automatically added, but 3 map features for players to choose from, accompanied by improved item quality found, transmog success rate, gold quantity found and other beneficial attributes.
  The hero feature related to the map feature has been cancelled.

4. Add a new currency: silver coins.
  Silver coins can be exchanged for gold coins in the mystery shop.
  The mystery shop now uses silver coins to buy props. Selling equipment no longer gets gold coins, but silver coins.
  Silver coins can also be obtained by recycling followers.

5. The max number of demon chests on each expedition is increased to 200.

6. Now the monsters on the map will also loot demon chests and currency, and the number of demon chests rewarded by the boss has been reduced.

7. The new featuregems will only have affixes modified to allies' attributes and affixes modified to follower level. And added a color distinction for the beneficial and harmful attributes of the featuregems.
  The map feature added by the featuregems can no longer be reset.

8. Adjusted the strength of each boss:
Reduced the max health and basic attack of each boss in Normal difficulty, and increased the max health, defense and basic attack of each boss in Nightmare and Hell difficulty.
  Increased the chance of bleeding caused by Desert Beast's attack to 100%, and increased the damage reflection to 20%.
  The chance of being poisoned by basic attacks of the Stinking Queen is increased to 50%.
  The Raptor Mecha removes the passive skill that reduction of cooldown when cause critical strikes and is modified to increase the spell critical strike by 50%.
  The Cruel Lord now has an attack range of 20 yards, and always attack the farthest enemy within range.

9.Now the enemy's strength will continue to grow until the 20th zone.

10. Fixed some bugs.

11. Modified game data.

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.notes:
After completing the normal difficulty game, the first featuregem solt is opened.
Completion on higher difficulty will open more featuregem solts.
Featuregems will increase the difficulty of the game.
The more featuregems, the higher the difficulty.
The game difficulty is divided into normal, hard, nightmare and hell now.

As the difficulty increases, the enemy becomes stronger and there will be more builds and combinations.
The default rarity of items found, lucky, quantity of gold found and other loots will also be increased, while more special items will appear, and more builds will be collected and gathered.
The number of demon chests and the probability of rare items being opened when you return to the tavern also increases with difficulty.

In addition, each featuregem will have different map affixes, so you can match the map effects for the next expedition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39086904/68ab6ebf318e48e85bb2f67c5818455ba84e0db7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.notes:
Legendary equipment can now be transmuted correctly, and artifact equipment can be obtained.

The transmog rules of legendary equipment are different from other quality equipment.

First of all, 3 different legendary equipment can be transmuted.(Other low-quality equipment transmog must be the same as 3 equipments)

Whether the transmog is successful or not,only the main equipment will be retained, and the 2 secondary equipments will be destroyed. (Lucky will increase the success of transmog)

Secondly, in addition to the original attribute improvement brought by the successful upgrade of transmog to become the artifact equipment, there will be an additional legendary attribute:

1.If the 3 equipments to transmute are not exactly the same and can activate a suit, the suit attribute will be added to the main equipment as a legendary attribute.

2.If the 3 equipments to transmute are not exactly the same and can not activate any suit, it will add the legendary attribute from a random secondary equipment to the main equipment.(Not same as the legendary attribute of the main equipment)

3.If the 3 equipments to transmute are exactly the same, a random legendary attribute will be added to the main equipment.(Not same as the legendary attribute of the main equipment)

Good Luck!
